summary: Show continuous idle eligibility and arm exact per-seat residency deadlines without suspending

replay.detail: Eligibility is derived from accepted runtime, harness, declaration, work and subagent evidence. Received mail and last_activity_at never define its epoch.

schema.detail: No authoritative storage schema transition. The driver persists channel handshake proof through existing extensible harness.diagnostic codes, not new harness.observed fields.

rules.detail: OMP alone supports eligibility. A confirmed native channel, quiet harness, no claimed work and no running subagents are required. The per-seat wake evaluation records the exact eligibility epoch plus configured threshold; due deadlines perform no suspension.

compatibility.detail: Optional client residency diagnostics are absent on older daemons. Unfamiliar refusal strings remain readable. New diagnostic codes use existing claim fields; no automatic idle suspend or resume writer is enabled.

downtime.detail: Policy settings hot-reload with daemon policies. Changed policy invalidates residency deadlines and cached agent cards, even at an unchanged claim cut. Enabling or loading enabled config on a fresh daemon clamps every seat's eligible epoch to that local time, conservatively waiting a full threshold after restart.

manual.detail: Use agents show to inspect policy, eligible since, due at and refusal reason. The default threshold remains off, and configuring a duration still does not stop a process in this release.

recovery.detail: Unknown or ineligible evidence clears the derived epoch. Repeated quiet observations and silent mail do not reset it. Binary replacement restores channel readiness only from a confirmed binding for the exact restored native session; pending or mismatched bindings remain unready. Existing manual suspension behavior is unchanged.
